tools.name: fmagenticl_resolve
tools.description: Deterministic sub-100ms lookup of a signed patch or verified workaround for an agent execution error. Accepts raw error traceback / exception strings (raw_error), package/tool names (target), or pre-computed SHA-256 fingerprints (fingerprint). Top supported targets: pydantic, litellm, crewai, langch

tools.name: fmagenticl_auto_heal
tools.description: Resolve and prepare a deterministic patch for application. Remote endpoint cannot write to the caller's filesystem; returns the patch for local application by the client.

tools.name: fmagenticl_report_telemetry
tools.description: Submit a verified self-healing patch to the registry.

tools.name: fmagenticl_submit_grievance
tools.description: Submit a structured infrastructure friction report with a verified workaround. Workaround is mandatory.

tools.name: fmagenticl_get_workarounds
tools.description: Query collective friction advisories and verified community workarounds for a specific target package or infrastructure tool. Top supported targets: pydantic, litellm, crewai, langchain, langgraph, mcp, fastmcp, uv, gitlab-cli, workers-sdk, wrangler, docker, git, powershell, sqlite, vllm, llama-inde

tools.name: fmagenticl_report_patch_outcome
tools.description: Report ACK (patch resolved the failure) or NACK (patch failed or stale). Three consecutive NACKs quarantine the patch.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "fmagenticl_resolve" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fmagenticl_resolve" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
